target: Published departure-record count per station/civil calendar day, not deduplicated unique rides, latent demand, bike stock or dock availability

initial_geometry.rationale: Preset regional/dispersion quality screens for recorded coordinates; untuned and not verified physical-station lineage
initial_geometry.radius_reference: Unrounded componentwise coordinate medians; grouping/model use four-decimal medians.

grouping: Connected components of first-quarter station medians within100m; sorted smallestID is component key. A proxy for related nearby IDs, not verified physical sites.

fold_rule.key: smallest station ID in connected coordinate group

predictor: At each target date use only donor dates in[t-W,t), matching weekday or weekday/weekend. Compute each donor mean; take k closest fixed-geometry donors and normalized inverse-distance-power weighted mean. Donor IDs break distance ties.

baseline.name: pooled_weekday_w84
baseline.predictor: Equal mean of all eligible donor means

selection.objective: Equal-coordinate-group MAE over all validation stations/days
selection.ties: Smaller k, lower exponent, shorter window, weekday before daytype; exact ties only
selection.scope: No target-station count history used; no held fold counts used for fitting/selection. First-quarter geometry/cohort construction uses source coordinates and activity eligibility; simulated cold start only.

held_geometry_stress.meaning: Synthetic metadata displacement with unchanged count labels, not measured physical relocation

bootstrap.interval: central95% empirical percentile resampling range; conditional finite-group sensitivity, not guaranteed future coverage

availability: Idealized complete prior-day published counts and known initial geometry only. Source files are posted later; actual historical information vintages and prospective feasibility are not verified.

floating_tolerances.meaning: Fixed numerical reconstruction tolerances, not source accuracy or physical-distance bounds.

public_scope: Noncommercial independent study with minimal coarse derived counts/rounded station geometry and original code/results/figures; no raw ride files, ride/customer/bike IDs, rider type, demographics, exact trip timestamps, trajectories, full manuals or logos
